title: D9 agent output (d9-repeat-finder)
description: Section 12/D9 'Agent output' line and .claude/agents/d9-repeat-finder.md's worked output shape: {"possible_repeats": [...], "none": true|false}. Spec 12/D9's Checks — 'ids exist, same subtopic, other year' — all need the per-item candidate table and live in scripts/checks/D9.py. D9 is deliberately INCLUSIVE ('if unsure, include'); a false candidate costs nothing because D11 removes it, while a missed repeat is lost forever. `note` is optional, carrying Universal rule 7 (added deliberately: its absence from schemas/D1.json/D2.json was a real bug, docs/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md 2026-10-12).

possible_repeats.description: Question ids from the input's `others` table only — same subtopic, OTHER year. Never this question's own id (the agent file's own Never rule). Must be empty exactly when `none` is true.

none.description: true when no other question in the table might test the same fact or problem. Must agree with possible_repeats being empty (checked in scripts/checks/D9.py).

oneOf.description: Universal rule 8: if the input file is missing or broken, the agent writes only {"error": "..."}.
